description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractHttpEndpoint' for handling HTTP endpoints within the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides common functionalities such as payload extraction, response handling, event bus communication, and CORS configuration, serving as a base for concrete HTTP endpoint implementations.

classes.name: AbstractHttpEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract base class for HTTP endpoints in Eclipse Hono, providing functions for payload extraction, response handling, event bus communication, and CORS setup.

methods.name: extractRequiredJson
methods.description: Checks Content-Type, extracts and validates JSON payload from RoutingContext, and stores it under a specified key.

methods.name: extractRequiredJsonPayload
methods.description: Extracts and validates JSON payload from RoutingContext expecting a JSON object.

methods.name: extractOptionalJsonPayload
methods.description: Extracts JSON payload if present; otherwise, sets an empty JSON object.

methods.name: extractRequiredJsonArrayPayload
methods.description: Extracts and validates JSON array payload from RoutingContext.

methods.name: getDefaultResponseHandler
methods.description: Creates a default HTTP response handler with conditional behavior based on status codes and optional custom handlers.

methods.name: sendAction
methods.description: Sends a message to the event bus and handles the response, setting headers and invoking response handlers.

methods.name: getTenantParam
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant ID from request parameters.

methods.name: getDeviceIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID from request parameters.

methods.name: extractIfMatchVersionParam
methods.description: Parses 'If-Match' headers for resource version control.

methods.name: createDefaultCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates a CORS handler allowing standard HTTP methods for a specified origin.

methods.name: createCorsHandler
methods.description: Creates a CORS handler with specific allowed methods.
